evidenceNote: Retailer product pages, exact sizes and official galleries checked October 14. New S/M stock and prices independently rechecked; LA corduroy uses XS/S and M/L, and Suitsupply maps regular38 to M. All new destination shipping totals and taxes remain unverified. Quince’s earlier ZIP10016 estimate was free delivery October18, not guaranteed. Decorative Non Stock Bolero was rejected despite cotton fabric; MUJI denim rejected for prominent chest pockets; Community Clothing pauses US delivery. Higher-price options remain for comparison, not affordability recommendations.
caveat: 100% natural outer fabric is not the same as an entirely natural or plastic-free garment. Organic cotton does not establish a health benefit or absence of dyes/finishes. No exact-product influencer endorsement or independently verified safety certification is claimed.
